===== PAGE 1 =====

Saturday 5 September 2026  |  start tonight
Start Now: What To Do
14 April 1992, 3:57 AM  |  Kathmandu
Maximum valid actions  |  how to do them  |  what to skip
Not medical, legal, or financial advice
Prepared 5 September 2026
HOW TO USE THIS FILE
Tonight pick THREE items from Track A (roof) and Track B (pay). Do them before you sleep. Do not wait until you have read
every page. Reading without a door is the old leak. If family is unsafe, skip family roofs. If you are in danger, go to people and a
public place first.
Clock you are in: Mars chapter until August 2029. Mercury sub-chapter until 21 February 2027. Mars pulse until about 13
September 2026: ask, apply, move. 13 September to 6 November: keep the roof, earn, research, do not sign fog. 6 November
to 24 December: put job and room on paper. A house in your name is 20 July 2027 to September 2028. Tonight's lockable
door has no waiting period.
1. Tonight and the next 48 hours
This is the only list that matters before you read the rest. Same hour. Do not reverse.
1. Name tonight's bed. Family if safe. Friend. Hostel. Staff room. Paying guest. Ashram bed. City shelter. A night bus is not a
plan. Ask out loud. Text. Call. Walk there.
2. If no private bed exists: Kathmandu Metropolitan rescue routes and Manav Sewa Ashram holding/shelter. Go while it is
still evening if you can. Public place with people if you are unsafe.
3. Bag of proof: citizenship/NID or copies, photos of documents on the phone, SIM that can receive OTP, a number someone
else also has, any bank/eSewa/Khalti login that still works.
4. One money ask tonight: a shift, a day labour, a paid errand, tutoring, a repair, a delivery, covering a class, helping a shop
close. Ask for rupees, not exposure.
5. Food and water that will last until morning. Heat in this chart crashes without food.
6. Sleep deadline. Even 5-6 hours. Exhaustion is how you cancel the next good chance.
7. One sentence to one human: 'I need a place to sleep and paid work this week. Can you help with either?' Not a life story.
8. Write three names who might have a floor, a shift, or an introduction. Contact all three tomorrow morning if not tonight.
9. Do not spend the last cash on a course, a gem, a drink to numb, or a 'guaranteed visa'. Do not marry or move in as housing.
Do not sign anything you cannot read twice.
10. If despair becomes not wanting to live: that is an emergency, not a chart. Tell someone. Local hospital emergency /
TUTH support. Wanting a house is a reason to stay. Use it on a door.
2. This week (5-13 September) -- use the Mars pulse


===== PAGE 2 =====

Start now  |  14 April 1992  |  Kathmandu
Do. Do not reverse.
Roof and repeating pay first. Title in 2027-28.
2
Until about 13 September, asking is cleaner than it will be in the foggy stretch that follows. Apply, knock, follow up. Expect a
first no. File the correction. Survival jobs have no forbidden month.
Day
Must finish
If extra energy
Sat 5 / Sun 6
Tonight's bed. Three contacts. Papers photo. Food.
List every skill you have been paid for, even once.
Mon 7
Five job/room asks. Walk into two places. SIM/wallet check.
One-page skill list with a price.
Tue 8
Follow up yesterday's nos. Second bed backup.
Clinic if infection, teeth, feet, fever.
Wed 9
One paid day if possible. Keep receipts.
Draft public rate: three offers, three prices.
Thu 10
Another five asks. Bank or wallet that can receive.
Short sit after labour. No extra puja instead of work.
Fri 11 / Sat 12
Lock next week's bed. Repeat pay. Sleep.
Copy all docs. Hide a spare copy with a trusted person.
From 13 Sep
Keep roof and pay. Research only on big offers.
Do not sign rushed lease or 'easy money'.
3. Daily operating system (do this every day)
Your mind will try to live 2028 today. Give it a small job. Confidence here is kept promises, not mood.
Morning (starter -- 20 minutes, same hour, no reverse)
- Feet on floor. Water. Wash if you can. Eat something.
- Open a note titled TODAY. Write only: (1) where I sleep tonight (2) how I get paid today (3) one named task I will finish.
- Send the first ask before you research. Application, wage question, room question, follow-up.
- If you feel the inspector say 'not yet', do the 20-minute version anyway.
Midday (inspector -- useful, finished, billed)
- Do paid work or hunt for it in a loop: apply, walk in, call, follow up. Five contacts is a valid day.
- Eat on a clock. This engine panics when blood sugar drops.
- One finished thing that has a name: a shift done, a message sent, a document copied, a room seen.
Evening (sponge needs a shore)
- Confirm tonight's door. If it is shaky, fix it before dark.
- Move the body 20-40 minutes: walk hills, stairs, labour, simple strength. Heat must leave the body or it becomes 3 a.m. rage.
- One honest sentence to a human if you spoke only in fog today.
- Screens and fortune-seeking close. Sleep is a duty, not a prize.
- Three-line journal: what I asked, what I finished, where I sleep. That is the proof pile.
THE 20-MINUTE RULE
When you already know the action, start it in the same hour for 20 minutes. Do not reverse. Applications, asks, and follow-ups
are same-day. Irreversible stamps (lease, loan, marriage, visa as escape, company) wait 72 hours and two written reads. Three
sources, then decide. A fourth research tab is the leak.
4. Track A -- roof (maximum valid options)
Rank by safety first, then lock, then cost, then pride last. A lockable door is a win. Shared is allowed. 'Not my house yet' is not
a reason to stay outside.
Option
How
Watch
Family if safe
Ask for a temporary bed in one sentence. Offer a small contribution or
chores. Put 'until when' in writing if you can.
Unsafe home: do not go. Leaving is not hatred.
Friend / relative floor
Text three people: dates, you will contribute, you will leave when you
have pay.
Do not become the unpaid nurse for the household.
Paying guest / shared room
Walk neighbourhoods you can work from. Ask shops who rents. See
the door lock.
From 13 Sep-6 Nov: keep looking, delay shady long
leases.
Hostel / lodge / night room
Pay night by night until weekly is possible. Keep receipts.
Do not drain the house-fund on a 'nice' hotel.
Staff housing
Ask every employer: is there a room with the job? Hotels, sites,
restaurants, hospitals, schools.
Get wages in writing even if the room is free.
Ashram / city shelter
Manav Sewa Ashram and KMC rescue if nowhere else. Go in person.
Follow their rules.
Temporary. Still hunt pay by day.


===== PAGE 3 =====

Start now  |  14 April 1992  |  Kathmandu
Do. Do not reverse.
Roof and repeating pay first. Title in 2027-28.
3
Option
How
Watch
Work-for-stay
Only if you also get cash or a clear end date. Write it.
Unpaid genius for a roof is the 12th-house trap.
Partner's house
Not this winter as the only plan. Friendship help for a few nights is
different from marrying the bed.
Do not use a person as medicine.
Housing actions to start now (do several in parallel)
- Make a list of every possible bed for the next 14 nights. Fill the nights. Gaps are the emergency.
- Visit two rooms this week even if they are imperfect.
- Ask every workplace about staff quarters.
- Photograph the lock, the rent, the landlord number. Verbal 'you can stay' is not a lease.
- Use a friend's address or a shelter address for job forms if you have no door yet.
- Keep a backup bed named at all times. One roof is not enough in this weather.
- From 6 Nov-24 Dec, if a decent room is real, put it on paper. Prefer that window for a longer agreement if you can last until
then without a shady autumn stamp.
- If you must take a room before 13 Sep because the street is the alternative, take it. Survival paper beats a perfect date.
- Start a house jar the week pay repeats: even a small amount you do not touch except a future legal deposit. Title is 2027-28.
The jar starts now.
- Do not buy land, plot 'deals', or 'invest now house later' in 2026 or Feb-Jul 2027.
5. Track B -- repeating pay (maximum valid options)
You are paid for named skill: starting, fixing, teaching a map, working under pressure, billed speech, useful hands,
investigation, training. You are not paid for being the hidden engine of someone else's shop. Ask the wage in writing. Take
legal repeating pay now. Named title can wait until Jul 2027-Sep 2028.
Immediate cash (this week -- pick all that you can actually do)
- Day labour and site work if the body allows: construction, loading, painting, warehouse. Mars year likes hands and a finish
line.
- Hospitality: kitchen, cleaning, night desk, banquet setup. Ask about staff food and a room.
- Delivery, riding, running parts, shop assistant, inventory counts.
- Tutoring (English, maths, computer, exam, astrology only if billed and bounded). One student is a start.
- Repairs and odd jobs: phones, bikes, plumbing help, electrical helper, computer format, CV typing for a fee.
- Paid errands for shops and offices: photocopy, banking line, inventory.
- Cover shifts for people you already know. Call them. 'I can work tomorrow.'
- Sell only what you can spare. Do not sell tools you need to earn.
- Do not: pyramid, forex guru, 'send passport + fee', betting, drinking for contacts, unpaid internships that promise a name
later.
Hireable crafts to plant now (income spine for 2027-28)
- Write a one-page menu of 3 services you can already do, with a price in rupees. Example: 'I fix X / I teach Y / I set up Z.
Rate: ...' Send it to 10 people this week.
- Technical or systems work: computer, accounts helper, operations, QA, documentation, support.
- Training and orientation: onboarding, how-to guides, exam coaching, workshop assistant.
- Investigation / research-for-hire that ends in a file, not a fog: due diligence, translation, field notes.
- Health-adjacent only with real credentials: do not play doctor. Support roles, first aid course, caregiving with a contract.
- Writing that orients: SOPs, CVs for a fee, clear explainers. Draft now. Soft offer 6 Nov-24 Dec. Bigger launch Jul 2027+.
- A short credential that leads to hire this winter (language, software, driving, hospitality certificate, first aid). Not a multi-year
prestige degree that delays rent.
- Keep a public name: WhatsApp business, a simple page, or even a printed rate card. Hidden genius does not get hired.
Job hunt method (Mercury sub-chapter: file, correct, file again)
- Target: 5 applications or walk-ins per weekday until pay repeats. Volume beats a perfect CV.


===== PAGE 4 =====

Start now  |  14 April 1992  |  Kathmandu
Do. Do not reverse.
Roof and repeating pay first. Title in 2027-28.
4
- Expect a first no. Ask 'what should I fix?' then send the correction the same day.
- Walk in on Monday-Wednesday mornings: restaurants, offices, sites, schools, clinics, shops.
- Follow up every no after 3 days, once. Then the next door.
- Ask in writing: wage, hours, overtime, food, room, start date. Screenshot.
- Do not quit a paying job Feb-Jul 2027 with no next page.
- Push for a written role 6 Nov-24 Dec 2026. Title and command: Jul 2027-Sep 2028.
- One ally who tells you to file beats a crowd that likes your potential. Ask one person to be that ally.
Money hygiene (Saturn delay wants accounts)
- One notebook or phone note: in, out, date. Every rupee. This chart leaks in private.
- Three pots when pay starts: (1) roof and food (2) house jar -- do not touch (3) tiny operating cash.
- Close leaks: drink, endless courses, lucky stones as a substitute for wages, 'one more plan', late-night spending.
- Charity of money only from surplus. Charity of hands is allowed now. Do not donate the rent.
- Borrow only for a documented roof or a documented job. Never for a scheme. No big debt 13 Sep-6 Nov or Feb-Jul 2027.
- If someone owes you, write it. If you owe, write it. Oral Magha/family pride fights get expensive.
6. Track C -- papers, phone, identity
- Photograph every document. Store copies with one trusted person and in an email to yourself.
- Citizenship / NID / passport status: know what is missing. Start replacement queues now; they are slow. Survival paperwork
can go in Nov-Dec if it is a real job/room. Do not file a fantasy visa 13 Sep-6 Nov.
- Working SIM in your name. Keep it charged. Share the number with two people.
- Bank account or eSewa/Khalti that can receive wages. If frozen, start the unfreeze this week.
- A mail/address for forms: friend, workplace, or shelter.
- CV of one page: name, phone, three skills, three proofs (even informal). Print 10 copies.
- Do not give original passport to an 'agent'. Copies only. 72 hours on any immigration story.
- Simple registration a job needs this winter: do it, preferably Nov-Dec if you can wait a few weeks without losing the job.
- Company registration, property, marriage stamp: not now. Harvest 2027-28.
7. Track D -- body (the engine that earns the house)
This is a hot, high-output chart. Street sleep, skipped meals, and no training turn heat into panic, gut trouble, and cancelled
chances. Not a diagnosis. Preventative attention: sleep, head/heat, gut-mood, teeth, feet, infections, nerves through early
2028. Injury risk rises Feb-Jul 2027 if you play hero.
- Sleep as a duty. Same window as possible. Even in a noisy room, pick a closing time.
- Meals on a clock. Protein and starch that do not punish you. Carry water.
- Feet, skin, teeth: wash, dry, cheap treatment early. Infections steal weeks.
- If you have fever, wound, chest, severe pain, or you cannot think: clinic/hospital. TUTH or the nearest emergency. Do not
astrologize an infection.
- Train 4 days when housed enough to recover: walk hills, labour, simple strength. Not only stretching. Heat must exit.
- No angry driving, no drunk nights, no 'I'll sleep when it's perfect'.
- Alcohol, excess cannabis, and all-night screens are 12th-house leaks for you. Closing time.
- One checkup this paperwork year when you have a door: blood pressure, teeth, anything you have been ignoring.
- Feb-Jul 2027: slower nights, no heroics, keep the job, keep the roof.
8. Track E -- mind (keep the three people on one calendar)
Starter, sponge, inspector. Therapy that only makes more insight feeds Mercury and starves Mars. You need a witness plus a
finished act.
- Daily: one preference in a short sentence. I want tea. I leave at 8. I sleep here. That is identity practice.
- When fog hits: feet on floor, cold water, 25-minute task, then rest on purpose. Do not open a fourth astrology tab.
- When shame hits: ask for one concrete thing. Let someone see an unfinished version of you.


===== PAGE 5 =====

Start now  |  14 April 1992  |  Kathmandu
Do. Do not reverse.
Roof and repeating pay first. Title in 2027-28.
5
- When rage/freeze hits: a walk, a clean no, no midnight essay. Morning act instead.
- People-pleasing test: if a choice makes you more likeable and less housed, it is not purpose. Skip it.
- Help only where you are paid, named, or truly willing. Charity after you have a bed.
- If you can access a counsellor: parts work + one weekly action. CBT as a broom for rumination. Body-based if possible. Not
a guru of fog.
- Mentors: people who finish things. Ask one craftsperson if you can watch or assist for pay.
- Limit fortune-seeking after dark. You already have dates. More charts will not lock a door.
- Reparenting: food, rest, feeling once through, then the next task. Not a new personality.
- If hopelessness becomes not wanting to be alive: emergency care. Chart work stops there.
9. Track F -- people (who to call, who to delay)
- Call: anyone with a floor, a shift, a tool, or an introduction. Lead with the ask.
- Keep: one ally who tells you to file. Tell them the 20-minute rule and ask them to check twice a week.
- Boundary: saviours who want your passport, last cash, or unpaid labour. Scams hunt desperation 13 Sep-6 Nov especially.
- Family talks: better 6 Nov-24 Dec, one topic, paper after. Not a war as a substitute for a roof. If family is safe, temporary
roof is strategy.
- Romance: talks Nov-Dec 2026; do not stamp Feb-Jul 2027; marry 20 Jul 2027-18 Sep 2028 if it is an equal, not a hospital.
Do not marry this winter for walls.
- Collaborations: skill partnerships ok. Foggy soulmate business in autumn 2026 is not. Paper in Nov-Dec. Formal partner
from Jul 2027.
- Do not manage other people's feelings as your job. Name your need first.
- From Jul 2027 the equal partner becomes loud karma. Practice spine now so you can choose then.
10. Track G -- craft, study, spirit, later paper
Craft and study now
- 2026: notes and one public sample of your skill (a page, a class, a before/after, a short guide).
- Study only what becomes hire this season. Languages, software, a licence, first aid, hospitality, driving, a trade helper role.
- Do not start a long prestige degree that delays income while you need a roof.
- Do not launch a company or a high-risk product now. Draft. Soft offer 6 Nov-24 Dec. Real launch Jul 2027-Sep 2028.
- Creative work: write. Do not premiere Feb-Jul 2027. Release and price in the harvest.
Spirit (earth under the mysticism)
- Daily: sleep, train, one kept promise, a few minutes quiet after the body is tired.
- Physical service: labour, showing up, helping with hands. Thursday money-gift only if there is extra.
- Short sitting or a simple mantra is fine if it ends in an action. Holy homelessness is not sattva for this life.
- Short retreat only Feb-Jul 2027 if you already have a roof -- not instead of a roof. Pilgrimage as escape from a job is a leak.
- No gemstone instead of a job. Stones are optional. Wages are not.
Relocation and big stamps
- Local move that is a roof + legal pay: allowed this month.
- Do not emigrate 13 Sep-6 Nov 2026 or Feb-Jul 2027 as escape. Prepare documents now. File real work/study paper Nov-Dec
if it includes a roof plan. Move as a housed worker Jul 2027-Sep 2028 or from 2029.
- Estate: as soon as you have a door and an account, write who gets the phone and the jar. Formal estate with the 2027-28 title.
11. What not to start now (these look like action and are not)
- Waiting for 2027 to take a lesser roof.
- A new personality, a new spiritual identity, a new branding week with no wage.
- Signing fog: easy money, rushed lease, passport-to-agent, 'invest now house later'.
- Marriage, company, land buy, visa-as-escape, huge debt.
- Unpaid 'I'll prove myself' labour with no end date.


===== PAGE 6 =====

Start now  |  14 April 1992  |  Kathmandu
Do. Do not reverse.
Roof and repeating pay first. Title in 2027-28.
6
- Family war, all-night research, fourth astrology file, gem-shopping.
- Using a partner as housing. Using pilgrimage as unemployment.
- Quitting a paying job in the 2027 cut-window with no next page.
- Heroic overwork that lands you in clinic -- especially Feb-Jul 2027.
12. Ninety days, then the harvest
When
You are working on
Done looks like

Named bed + at least one cash day + papers copied
13 Sep-6 Nov
Keep roof. Repeat pay. Research offers. No foggy stamps

refused
6 Nov-24 Dec
Job/room on paper. Talks. Rate card. Family one-topic talks
Written wage or written room. Public price. Docs in queue
Late Dec-21 Feb 2027
Finish, save, sleep, checkup. Do not launch a firm
House jar started. Body not in crisis. Role kept
21 Feb-20 Jul 2027
Endings, rest, keep roof and job. Edit, do not premiere
Still housed. No land/wedding/company stamp
20 Jul 2027-Sep 2028
Named work, deposit/title, equal partner if real, visa-as-plan
Title or build start. Price. Name people can hire
Reassess: January 2027 (before the cut-window), June 2027 (pick harvest dates), after early 2028 (when worry-weather thins).
IF YOU REMEMBER ONLY THIS
Tonight: a door, a money ask, sleep. This week: five asks a day, papers copied, heat out of the body. Until February 2027:
repeating pay and a roof you would once have refused. Do not stamp land, marriage, company, or escape-visa in the fog. July
2027-September 2028 is when the house in your name can begin -- if 2026 kept you alive and employable. The sentence that
ruins this chart is 'I'll do it properly later.' Do the 80 percent version tonight.
Same nativity as your other files. Survival housing now. Own-house harvest 2027-28. This is a map of useful action, not a guarantee, diagnosis, or legal
plan.
